_comment: OverCut makes no network request beyond its own assets (docs/PRODUCT.md, ADR 0005, XT-06). tests/smoke/network.spec.ts fails on any request whose host is not listed here. Adding a host needs a reason in docs/ (an ADR or docs/features/privacy-network.md) in the same PR, and the user must be able to decline the feature that uses it. Entries are exact hostnames; 'sameOrigin' allows the page's own host.
